$description: Reconciliation of the kit code with the designer's Figma colour bindings (design-system/tokens/figma-bindings/). One row per primitive or semantic colour class of the component map plus every colour class of Button. Matching a code part to a Figma layer and variant is judgement (`confidence`; low = verdict `uncertain`). Verdicts are computed against the start commit `base`: `agree` (same token), `figma-differs-adoptable` (the Figma token holds, or can be set to, today's colour for every user of that token, so the code can take it with no pixel change), `figma-differs-conflict` (taking it would change today's colour here or elsewhere), `figma-primitive-or-raw`, `no-figma-match`, `uncertain`. `today` is the default-theme colour (primitive step, `/alpha`, `shadow:` size); `figmaDefaultBefore` is the Figma token's default-theme value at `base` (computed by the fallback rule when unverified); `figmaLight`/`figmaDark` are its Figma values. `action` says what this branch did with an adoptable row.
